name: RLE Index Computation
definition: Computes an index mapping 3D voxel coordinates to RLE run data. The index stores byte offsets to the beginning of the run containing the voxel, plus a count indicating the position of the voxel within that run.
summary: RLE Index Computation generates a lookup structure mapping 3D voxel coordinates to RLE run offsets, enabling direct O(1) access to run headers unlike raw storage.
